lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's four? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 4? Nope!

lines.text: What is the smallest n, so three to the n ends in zero one?
lines.caption: What is the smallest n, so 3ⁿ ends in 01?

lines.text: The last digit loops: three, nine, seven, one. So only every fourth power ends in one.
lines.caption: The last digit loops: 3, 9, 7, 1. So only every 4th power ends in 1.

lines.text: Three to the fourth is eighty-one. To jump four more powers, multiply by eighty-one.
lines.caption: 3⁴ is 81. To jump 4 more powers, multiply by 81.

lines.text: The tens digit drops by two. Sixty-one, forty-one, twenty-one, and then zero one!
lines.caption: The tens digit drops by 2. 61, 41, 21, and then 01!

lines.text: Five jumps of four powers. So n is twenty!
lines.caption: 5 jumps of 4 powers. So n is 20!

lines.text: Four was the trap. Eighty-one ends in one, but not zero one.
lines.caption: 4 was the trap. 81 ends in 1, but not 01.

lines.text: Did you get twenty? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 20? Tell me below!
